mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id, actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, detail, occurred_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detail}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.sql: WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.occurred_at >= #{since} AND a.action = #{action}
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.actor_id, u.display_name AS actor_name, a.action, a.target_type, a.target_id, a.detail, a.occurred_at FROM audit_log a LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = a.actor_id
ORDER BY a.occurred_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
